scope: Prospective diagnostic 2x2: fixed/joint K_Pst update heads x coefficient-only/timing-Jacobian objective; frozen baseline and saved41q equilibrium control
coefficient_objective: Same original41p16384 anchors. Existing-head probability Jacobian, teacher probability residual, normalization1e-4/sqrt(N), relative SVD ridge1e-6. Uniform frozen-K cell reuses saved41q joint_nap weights exactly; q_equilibrium also reused exactly.
timing_objective: Teacher training paths from registered new fit seeds, same4 stress families. At evaluable reference onset/offset crossings and +/-1tick, linearize baseline currents through the FULL causal affine gate recurrence and existing frozen features. Residual and Jacobian divided by max(abs(reference current slope)*original onset_offset_max_ms,1e-10), then sqrt(event row count). Solve one regularized linearized step around coefficient-fit weights, penalized in the same coefficient/SVD geometry. No unreachable frozen-z trajectory terms; no model formulas in inference.
trainable_heads: Original equilibrium heads8,9,11,12,13,16 and Nap update8,9; joint-K adds existing K_Pst update12,13 (parent c/d columns29,30). All trunks, donor and other heads frozen. No new layers, parameters, inference operations or step-size change.
nomination: Before opened41n evaluation, compare new-development cases to frozen baseline case by case. Only nonregressing candidates with pass count>=baseline are eligible; highest count then preregistered arm order. Baseline fallback if none. Report all arms regardless; no sealed confirmation.
progress: More than61/72 opened stress with no new stress failure, no new development failure vs baseline, no acquired imposed or autonomous trajectory/response regression. hypotheses.saved_fit_transfer: The saved41q coefficient fits improve at least some GPU stress timing; coefficient RMSE alone is not sufficient.
hypotheses.joint_K: Allowing K_Pst update repair removes the frozen-rate compensation conflict and reduces K_Pst failures without regressions.
hypotheses.timing: Causal crossing-current Jacobian weighting improves actual unchanged timing gates beyond coefficient-only fits.
hypotheses.interaction: Joint K update and timing weighting may be complementary; report paired per-case contrasts and their interaction, not only the best arm.

limits: All new fits are deterministic local linearized diagnostic calibration, not a global optimum guarantee
Current Jacobian fit uses imposed training paths; autonomous transfer is tested separately
Old41n is opened diagnostic data, not independent confirmation
Original FP32 failures remain explicit; no deployment qualification

quality.normalization: For each trajectory/channel S=max(max_t abs(I_reference),1e-7 mA/cm2). Charge errors divided by duration*S, not near-zero signed target charge. Report absolute errors and peak-relative charge diagnostics as well. No averaging across regimes to waive a failed critical gate.
quality.event_support: Transient timing evaluated only when reference peak-baseline contrast >=25% of S, peak >=10*floor, and peak is internal to the window. Other cases explicitly not_evaluable; amplitude/current gates still apply. Onset/offset use 10% of reference transient amplitude. Multi-event morphology needs dedicated matching in closed-loop stage.
